newsitem.title: ITALY: Man and two sons shot dead in Naples.
newsitem.headline: Man and two sons shot dead in Naples.

text.p: A man and his two sons were shot dead outside their home on Tuesday in an attack thought to have been carried out by the Neapolitan Mafia, the Camorra.
Police said the men were gunned down as they emerged from the house in a suburb of this southern Italian port city.
The Italian government recently sent 500 troops and 200 police to Naples to quell in-fighting between rival Camorra clans which has claimed almost 100 lives this year.
